description: tikajs-uay4: the header, footer and left header regions of a master page are written in the order styles.xml has them, as their paragraphs alone (no wrapping block that adds a blank line), and text:page-number and text:page-count give no text. ripstream wrote 'Page 1 of 9' and an empty line after each region (corpus odt/unicode 0.667 against Tika's 1.000), and no left or first regions. Written by scripts/make-odt-repros.ts. Expected text read off Apache Tika 4.2.0 (/rmeta/body) for the same bytes.
